title: Phase 0: CLI contract test suite (executable spec, written first)
P0.1 Contract harness: spawn-binary test scaffolding
description: Foundation for ALL contract tests (plan §14 Phase 0). Build a Rust integration-test harness in crates/pst/tests/contract/ that: (1) locates the compiled pst binary (env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_pst")), (2) spawns it with PST_HOME pointed at a fresh mktemp-style temp dir per test (tempfile crate), (3) provides a run() helper returning (stdout, stderr, exit_code) triples with byte-exact capture, (4) supports piping stdin and asserting non-TTY behavior by connecting pipes to stdout/stderr (atty is false in that mode — this is what triggers auto-JSON for enumeration commands). WHY FIRST: plan locks the output contract as THE product API for AI agents; every later phase is driven green against these red tests. Acceptance: harness compiles, one trivial smoke assertion runs the binary with --version style flag or errors cleanly on missing DB; zero disk leakage outside temp dirs.

title: P0.2 Contract tests: direct mode output triples
description: Freeze direct-mode behavior per plan §6 Output Contract and §14 Phase 0. Tests (each asserts exact stdout bytes, stderr bytes, exit code): pst <id> with existing prompt -> content+\n on stdout, empty stderr, exit 0; pst <id> --json -> stable JSON payload {id,title,content,description?,category?,tags[],variables?,version?,use_count,last_used_at}; pst <id> --copy -> Copied: <title> on stderr, exit 0 (clipboard tool stubbed via PATH shim); unknown query -> stdout EMPTY, stderr {"error":"not_found","query":"..."}, exit 1; ambiguous prefix -> stderr {"error":"ambiguous","candidates":[{id,title,score}...]}, exit 1; pst foo | cat equivalence -> byte-equal content when stdout is a pipe. Seeds fixtures via JSONL import (P1 dependency) or a test-only seeding helper. These are RED until Phase 2 lands. Acceptance: suite compiles, all cases expressed, deterministic (no clipboard/flake dependence).

title: P0.3 Contract tests: enumeration commands auto-JSON
description: Per plan §6 principles: ONLY enumeration commands (list/search/suggest/categories/tags/status/doctor) auto-switch to JSON when stdout is not a TTY; direct mode NEVER does. Tests: pst list with piped stdout -> JSON array payload {prompts:[...],count:N}; pst search x piped -> ranked JSON results with scores; pst categories / tags piped -> JSON; explicit --json flag forces JSON even on TTY-shaped runs; global flags --json/-j and --no-color accepted everywhere; NO_COLOR/PST_NO_COLOR env respected (no ANSI escapes in output). RED until Phase 2/4. Acceptance: enumeration contract cases compiled and running against harness.

title: P1.1 Crate scaffold + workspace + lib boundary
description: Per plan §3 Architecture. Create workspace Cargo.toml (deps mirror crates/: clap derive, rusqlite bundled, serde, serde_json, anyhow, chrono, rand, atty, directories, toml, sha2; ratatui+crossterm reserved for P5 but declared now to fail-fast compile issues; dev-deps tempfile). crates/pst with src layout: lib.rs exposing core modules (model/, storage/, render/), main.rs thin dispatch stub, model/prompt.rs (Prompt, PromptVariable, VariableType enum text|multiline|select|file|path with serde), empty module skeletons for storage/{schema,database,jsonl,resolve}.rs, render/mod.rs, commands/ dir. RULE (locked): commands/* and tui/* contain presentation only; all DB/resolve/render logic lives under lib-exposed core so integration tests and TUI exercise identical code paths. Acceptance: cargo build green, cargo test runs empty suite, module tree matches plan tree.

title: P1.2 Schema v1 + forward-only migration runner
description: Per plan §4. Implement storage/schema.rs: LATEST_SCHEMA_VERSION=1; MIGRATIONS ordered append-only slice where entry i upgrades i-1->i; migration 0->1 creates full schema: prompts (id PK kebab-case, title, content, description, category, tags_text denormalized-for-FTS, version, author, difficulty, featured, source manual|imported, use_count, last_used_at, created_at, updated_at), aliases (alias TEXT PRIMARY KEY COLLATE NOCASE -> prompt_id ON DELETE CASCADE), prompt_tags (composite PK, CASCADE), prompt_variables (AUTOINCREMENT id, name UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, var_type default text, required, description, default_value), collections (name COLLATE NOCASE PK), collection_prompts (composite PK, added_at), prompts_fts FTS5(id,title,description,content,tags_text), idx_prompts_category, idx_prompt_tags_tag, meta(key,value). run_migrations(): PRAGMA user_version is source of truth (NOT a meta row); each migration inside BEGIN..COMMIT with user_version bump in same tx; REJECT databases with user_version > LATEST (downgrade guard) with clear error. WHY: schema evolution must never brick user DBs (plan §16 locked decision). Acceptance unit tests: fresh DB gets v1; re-open idempotent; downgrade-guard rejects newer DB; migration list append-only by construction.

title: P1.3 Database wrapper: pragmas + tx-wrapped mutations
description: Per plan §4 operational rules, patterns proven in storage/database.rs. Database::open(): create parent dirs; journal_mode=WAL, synchronous=NORMAL, busy_timeout=5s, foreign_keys=ON; run_migrations. Database::in_memory() for tests (zero disk). Mutations ALL inside one transaction including SINGLE-prompt upsert (bug we fix: only bulk was tx-wrapped). upsert_prompt: INSERT..ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE on prompts; delete+reinsert tags; delete+reinsert variables; delete+reinsert FTS row — atomically. get_prompt loads tags+variables. list_prompts_filtered(category,tag,featured). category_counts/tag_counts/prompt_count. search(query,limit): FTS5 MATCH with BM25 weights id=5,title=3,description=2,content=1,tags_text=2; NEGATE returned score for ranking (BM25 negative quirk, ); escape_fts_query applied before MATCH (special chars must never panic). get_meta/set_meta on meta table. Acceptance unit tests on in_memory(): roundtrip upsert/get with tags+variables preserved; FTS search ranking correct and escaped; side-effect assertions (FTS rows match prompts rows after every mutation).

title: P1.4 JSONL atomic export/import
description: Per plan §4 rule 4 and §9 format. export: first line {"_meta":{version,count,exported_at,schema_version}} then one prompt per line EMBEDDING its variables AND aliases array ({"id","title","content","description?","category?","tags":[],"variables":[...],"aliases":[...]}); write to <path>.tmp, fsync, atomic rename; WINDOWS caveat: remove destination before rename (-90). import: skip _meta lines (only treat first non-empty line as meta if it has _meta key), parse each line with per-line error context, modes --merge (upsert by id) and --replace (wipe tables + insert in ONE transaction), REJECT files whose schema_version > LATEST. Round-trip guarantee is a locked contract: export -> destroy DB -> import -> every prompt byte-identical incl aliases+variables restored. Acceptance tests: roundtrip byte-equal content, merge preserves unrelated existing prompts, replace wipes cleanly, corrupt line yields actionable error with line number.

title: P2.1 Resolution engine: exact/alias/prefix/FTS + ambiguity
description: Heart of pst, plan §5. storage/resolve.rs with decision order: (1) EXACT prompts.id==query; (2) ALIAS aliases.alias==query COLLATE NOCASE; (3) PREFIX over ids-union-aliases: exactly 1 -> hit, more -> AMBIGUOUS with candidates sorted use_count DESC then alpha; (4) FUZZY FTS BM25 top-k=8: top1 beats top2 by >=40% AND passes min-score floor -> hit with stderr notice, leading-but-not-decisive -> AMBIGUOUS scored candidates, none -> NOT_FOUND. Hits from steps 3-4 bump use_count+last_used_at in one tx. HARD RULE ambiguity policy: NEVER pick when unclear; candidates table to stderr plus {"error":"ambiguous","candidates":[...]} exit 1 — an agent silently receiving wrong content is the worst failure mode (plan invariant #2). Naming invariants enforced inside insert transaction: canonical id regex ^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*$; alias regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,199}$; alias must not equal ANY canonical id exact or case-insensitively (FOO vs foo forbidden since lookup is NOCASE); alias unique among aliases NOCASE; violations return alias_conflict/id_conflict. Race-free because check-and-insert share one tx under WAL single-writer. Acceptance: EXHAUSTIVE unit matrix — every branch of the decision tree, use_count tie-break behavior, all collision cases.

title: P2.2 Argv prescan for dynamic --VAR=value tokens
description: Per plan §7 sharp-edge section. main.rs pre-scans argv BEFORE clap: token grammar ^--[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=(.*)$ split on FIRST = only; matching tokens extracted into Vec<(String,String)> and removed so clap parses remainder normally. RESERVED-FLAG PRECEDENCE: names matching real flags (--json,--no-color) never become variables; --json=x is a hard error. Edge battery REQUIRED as tests: --FOO= empty value ok; --FOO=a=b keeps second equals; --foo=bar accepted but case-sensitive substitution will not match {{FOO}} — warn on stderr when name differs only by case from a declared variable; --A_B=123; shell-unquoted values arrive intact. Unknown names appearing nowhere -> stderr warning, never fatal (typo catcher). WHY separate bead: this is the most pain-prone surface; clap cannot declare arbitrary flags; CLI frameworks force hand-parsing here. Acceptance: edge battery green in isolation before any command consumes variables.

title: P2.3 Core commands: direct/get/show/new/edit/rm/alias/unalias
description: Per plan §8 command surface. Implement presentation modules calling core only: direct mode (pst <query> default subcommand + pst get alias) rendering per §6 contract — raw content+newline stdout silent stderr exit 0; fuzzy hits print one-line resolved-q->id notice to stderr; show = human metadata+preview view (NEVER the piped-content path); new (primary; add is alias) reading content from --from FILE | - stdin | $EDITOR when TTY, refusing duplicates unless --force, validating id regex and metadata flags (--title/--desc/--category/--tag repeatable/--difficulty/--author); edit via $EDITOR on temp file in same dir, update in one tx only if changed, TTY-only with non-TTY error pointing at new --from -; rm confirm-on-TTY --force bypass; alias/unalias with collision invariants from P2.1 surfaced as clean errors. Global flags --json/-j --no-color plus NO_COLOR/PST_NO_COLOR env. Acceptance: P0.2 contract tests flip green; golden JSON payloads for get --json frozen.

title: P2.4 Discovery commands: list/search/suggest/categories/tags/random
description: Per plan §8 discovery block. list|ls with --category/--tag/--featured/--limit filters via list_prompts_filtered, table output human / {prompts,count} JSON piped; search FTS BM25 ranked with escaped query; suggest FTS + reason-string generation  for task descriptions; categories/tag counts sorted: categories alphabetically, tags by count desc; random choose via rand with optional category/tag filter and --copy. ALL of these auto-JSON on non-TTY stdout per §6 principle (enumeration-only rule). Acceptance: P0.3 contract tests green for these commands; filter combinations covered by unit tests.

title: P3.1 Render engine: variables, defaults, file/path vars, context, fill
description: Per plan §7 full behavioral spec. render/mod.rs in CORE (not commands): placeholder {{VAR_NAME}} regex case-sensitive; UNFILLED placeholders pass through untouched; declared default_value applies when no explicit value; dynamic defaults CWD and PROJECT_NAME from process cwd; type behaviors — file reads file content into value capped 102400 bytes with suffix notice [File truncated to 102400 bytes from <N> bytes], path passes string as-is; --fill interactive prompting for missing vars (text/multiline/select/file/path), Ctrl+C -> {"error":"cancelled"} exit 130, non-TTY+--fill errors pointing at explicit --VAR= flags; missing required without --fill -> missing_variables error listing names; context injection --context FILE flat JSON or TOML and --stdin which WINS if both, --max-context byte cap default 204800. Acceptance unit tests: substitution matrix, defaults precedence explicit>dynamic>declared-default, truncation notice exact bytes, pass-through of unfilled placeholders.

title: P3.2 Clipboard + copy command
description: Per plan §8 execution block. clipboard.rs: detect platform tool pbcopy|xclip|xsel|clip via PATH probe (NO clipboard crate — keep binary lean, locked decision); spawn with stdin pipe feeding content; copy command resolves prompt (P2.1), applies variable filling when --fill or --VAR= given using P3.1 engine, copies final content, stderr Copied: <title>, TTY shows short preview, piped stdout shows nothing per §6. Acceptance: PATH-shim fake clipboard tool in tests asserts exact stdin bytes; contract test P0.2 --copy case green.

title: P3.3 Export/import commands + markdown export + path safety
description: Per plan §8 portability block wiring P1.4 core to CLI: export with --ids/--all/--format jsonl|md/--out PATH|DIR/--stdout; markdown export format (title heading, description, category/tags lines, content); safe-filename derivation from ids plus resolved-path containment checks (path traversal guard — unsafe id exits 2); import command exposing merge/replace modes. Acceptance: roundtrip e2e export->wipe->import byte-equal; traversal attempts rejected; --stdout prints raw without JSON wrapper.

title: P4.1 Collections: CRUD + markdown export
description: Per plan §8 grouping block. collections (list all), collection <name> detail with member list, create --desc, add/remove members (prompt-id lists), delete, export --format md --out/--stdout producing ordered member markdown. Names follow alias safe-id regex; NOCASE uniqueness via schema PK collation. Acceptance unit tests: CRUD roundtrip, cascade delete removes memberships not prompts, export markdown correct ordering and content.

title: P4.2 System commands: config TOML + status
description: Per plan §7 config file and §8 system block. Config at ~/.config/pst/config.toml (PST_HOME overrides): keys output.color/output.json/skills dirs reserved for P6/suggest.default_limit/mcp removed from v1 — keep only keys in plan §7 final table. config subcommands get|set|list|reset|path: validate key against defaults, parse value type from default type, atomic temp+rename writes. status: db path/exists/prompt count/schema version/meta markers as {database:{...}} JSON piped / human table on TTY. Acceptance: set/get typed roundtrip, unknown key invalid_key error, reset restores defaults, atomicity under simulated crash (temp leftover ignored).

title: P4.3 doctor: health checks + FTS drift detection + --fix repair
description: Per plan §12. Checks each ok/warn/fail JSON-friendly: database opens + integrity_check passes; schema_version==LATEST warn-if-older note; FTS consistency via SELECT id FROM prompts EXCEPT prompts_fts AND inverse — any diff = fail with counts; editor available ($EDITOR/$VISUAL); clipboard tool present (pbcopy|xclip|xsel|clip); skill presence checks added later in P6 bead. --fix: wipe+rebuild prompts_fts from prompts inside ONE transaction then re-verify (recovery op replaces any public refresh command per locked scope). Acceptance: test injects artificial drift (delete FTS rows directly) -> doctor fails with counts -> --fix heals -> clean.

title: P5.1 TUI picker (pst i): ratatui, thin core consumer
description: Per plan §10 REQUIRED core UX. tui/mod.rs with ratatui+crossterm: search input with incremental filter using the SAME core search as pst search (zero duplicated logic — locked rule); result list navigation; Enter -> action menu copy / print-to-stdout-after-exit / preview pane; Ctrl-C clean exit restoring terminal via alternate-screen teardown plus panic hook so crashes never leave a broken terminal. Budgets: first paint <=150ms on few-thousand-prompt library; keystroke-to-filter within 16ms frame budget. Non-TTY invocation of pst i errors suggesting pst search. Acceptance: scripted PTY test covers open/filter/select/exit asserting screen states and full terminal restoration; manual smoke on macOS Terminal + WezTerm.

title: P6.1 Integration skill generator: prompt-storage SKILL.md
description: Per plan §11. skills/skill_md.rs generates ONE integration skill named prompt-storage: what pst is (local DB-backed prompt registry), command cheatsheet (pst <id>, pst search, pst suggest, pst render --VAR=...), and the five behavioral rules VERBATIM from plan §11 gated on conditional reuse: When a task would benefit from a reusable prompt or workflow: search first; prefer existing relevant prompt over recreating; retrieve with pst <id> raw stdout; use render when variables/context required; never guess when ambiguous. Plus explicit anti-pattern note: agents must NOT run pst search reflexively on every request — weigh latency/token cost. Include PST_HOME scoping note. Acceptance: golden-file test freezes generated SKILL.md content; five rules present verbatim.

title: P6.2 Agent adapters + install/uninstall
description: Per plan §11. skills/agents.rs trait AgentAdapter {env_present(), skill_paths(), wire(), verify()} with claude (<root>/.claude/skills/prompt-storage symlink -> ../../.agents/skills/prompt-storage) and codex (.codex sibling), copy fallback where symlinks unsupported. Canonical ALWAYS written first to <root>/.agents/skills/prompt-storage/SKILL.md (root = project dir via .git heuristic or $HOME per --project/--personal); adapter failures reported never fatal. install idempotent: sha256 of canonical vs regenerated — unchanged no-op, changed regenerate, --force rewrite. UNINSTALL INVARIANT (locked): removes ONLY canonical dir + links pst owns (link is ours iff resolves to canonical; copied file ours iff byte-matches regenerated); NEVER deletes any prompts/collections/db rows; foreign files untouched. doctor gains checks: skill present at .agents/skills/, each adapter link resolves and hash matches. Acceptance: double-install single-dir test; tamper detection by doctor; uninstall leaves DB intact and foreign files alone.

title: P7A.1 Release engineering: README, CI matrix, SHA256SUMS, installer
description: Per plan §14 Phase 7A v1 finale (self-update explicitly deferred beyond v1). README with quick-start + command surface + performance table; scripts/build-releases.sh; GitHub Actions release workflow matrix darwin/linux x arm64/x64 producing binaries + SHA256SUMS.txt; curl-pipe install.sh (macOS/Linux) downloading release asset, verifying checksum, installing to ~/.local/bin or /usr/local/bin with PST_HOME untouched. Asset naming convention: pst-<os>-<arch>. Acceptance: installer works locally on macOS arm64 against a local artifact; released binary passes scripts/smoke.sh in CI.

title: E2E.1 Smoke script + perf bench harness
description: Per plan §13/§15. scripts/smoke.sh: fresh PST_HOME temp dir, full lifecycle new->get->alias->prefix->fuzzy->render->install->export->wipe->import->get byte-equal plus doctor --fix healing injected FTS drift; detailed step logging with pass/fail summary exit code. scripts/bench.sh: seed synthetic 10k-prompt library, measure p95 end-to-end (process spawn included): exact-id <=30ms, unique-prefix <=30ms, search <=50ms, render <=40ms; fail loudly when budgets exceeded (TUI first-paint covered by PTY test instead). Acceptance: smoke green locally; bench reports table and enforces budgets.

Budgets: first paint <=150ms on few-thousand-prompt library; keystroke-to-filter within 16ms frame budget. Non-TTY invocation of pst i errors suggesting pst search.
